name: Nebula Kite Grove
description: A grove where kite‑shaped leaves drift in a nebula wind, each leaf glowing with stellar hues.
prompt: A tranquil grove of tall trees whose leaves are shaped like delicate kites. A gentle nebula wind blows, causing the leaves to flutter and glow in shifting stellar colors—magenta, cyan, gold. Soft focus, dreamy, 8k.
caption: Leaves that fly on cosmic breezes. 🌬️🪁
